changed_reading.after: They invert the orienting work of representation itself, converting repeated clarification into a mechanism of increasing recoil.
changed_reading.before: Their own comparisons happen to lead them astray.

context_deltas.mechanism: Varied presentation is meant to recover remembrance, yet its observed result is increased recoil. This revises the focus sequence into an inversion of representational pedagogy: forms meant to turn attention toward recognition are processed into further turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two presentation-result sequences; I infer that the earlier reversal diagnoses how representation is being received in the focus. A live alternative is that prior refusal, rather than representation itself, causes the recoil.
structural_cues: In 17:41, varied presentation is ordered before remembrance, increase, and recoil; 17:48 likewise orders comparison-making before loss and incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the act of casting the addressee into a controlling type.
Makes the likeness function as an asserted description.
Contributes attribution of an unreal or unsupported condition through speech.
Turns the imposed description into a directional claim about following.
Supplies diversion and deception as the content of the type imposed on the addressee.

changed_reading.after: At least one live example is a typecasting speech act: label the messenger as diverted, then use the label to divert the audience's route of following.
changed_reading.before: The examples are unspecified bad analogies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding speech casts the addressee as a deceptive or affected human type and then uses that type to route whom others should follow. The focus comparisons are therefore not neutral illustrations but accusatory classifications that pre-decide reception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an accusation, a following relation, and a diversion image; I infer that this utterance is one concrete comparison targeted by the focus. It could instead be only the latest insult in a broader unstated set.
structural_cues: The quoted exclusive assertion in 17:47 immediately precedes the command to inspect their comparisons in 17:48.

activation_trace.role: Allows the focus loss to be hiddenness or disappearance rather than only doctrinal deviation.
Supplies the route whose perceptual access is being closed.
Places a barrier that prevents arrival from one side to the other.
Adds a preserving cover that seals the inner site of understanding.
Loads the auditory channel with weight so reception cannot become guidance.
Completes enclosure with active distancing and withdrawal.

changed_reading.after: Their imposed models cooperate with closed receptive channels until the route itself disappears from perceptual and cognitive availability.
changed_reading.before: They see possible routes but select a false one.

context_deltas.mechanism: Barriers, protective coverings, auditory weight, and recoil close the channels through which a route could be perceived and entered. Loss in the focus therefore includes disappearance of the route inside an enclosure, not only choosing the wrong road after seeing alternatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked channels and then a missing route; I infer that the former specify the phenomenology of the latter. Whether those barriers are imposed causes or descriptions of prior refusal remains open.
structural_cues: A barrier between parties, coverings over hearts, failed understanding, burden in ears, and backs turned accumulate across 17:45-46 before the focus.

Reframes every material kind as something first measured and formed, undermining its use as an absolute limit.

changed_reading.after: Their examples also operate as material thought-models that mistake a created condition for a limit on the creator's power to restore.
changed_reading.before: Their examples are mainly verbal insults about the messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus challenge escalates through disintegrated remains, stone, iron, and a still greater created kind. These are material models used to set a limit on re-creation; their error is treating the pictured state of matter as the measure of what its originator can do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of material categories around the focus; I infer that these are forward-facing examples of the comparison habit condemned there. A live alternative is that the focus points chiefly backward to the accusation in 17:47.
structural_cues: Immediately after 17:48, the objection names remains, then the reply escalates through stone, iron, and whatever seems greater before asking who restores.

activation_trace.role: Supplies yielding compliance as a live color within the negated capacity.
Keeps practical ability as the explicit focus condition.
Supplies the stirring of what appears materially motionless.
Locates renewed possibility in the agency that first originated them.
Provides the summons that initiates movement beyond present incapacity.
Provides the answering response that completes the future compliance.

changed_reading.after: They presently refuse the yielding capacity by which a route becomes actionable, yet the originating call will eventually make even their dispersed material answer.
changed_reading.before: They lack the intellectual power to find an argument.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people who cannot bring themselves into an effective route are placed in a resurrection sequence where the originator calls and they answer. Material stasis is stirred and opened by a call-response relation, exposing present incapacity as failed willing conformity rather than a final physical impossibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present incapacity and future call-response; I infer a contrast between voluntary receptive failure now and unavoidable effective response later. The later answer need not imply willing obedience, so the contrast is stronger than an identity.
structural_cues: The sequence moves from disbelief in renewed creation to origination, a future summons, and an answering response.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the focus route as a means of reaching an endpoint.
Makes the alleged peers seekers rather than terminal destinations.
Supplies elevated sovereignty as the endpoint toward which their own premise points.
Provides an explicit contextual road sought toward that sovereign endpoint.
Tests whether invoked agents possess effective disposal and control.
Defines one missing power as lifting the covering obstruction.
Defines the other missing power as changing a state or rerouting it.
Makes the invoked beings competitors in seeking approach to God, not self-sufficient termini.

changed_reading.after: Their examples generate an untraversable theology: every supposed intermediary points beyond itself, cannot clear or transform harm, and therefore cannot serve as the route's endpoint.
changed_reading.before: They cannot find a persuasive line of reasoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding route tests form a dependency map: alleged divine peers would themselves seek a road toward sovereignty; invoked beings cannot own removal or transformation; and those invoked seek nearness. Their examples fail to yield a route because every proposed intermediary is itself oriented beyond itself and lacks terminal agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeking, route, sovereignty, lack of control, and sought nearness; I infer a single topology in which dependent intermediaries cannot terminate the path. A live alternative reads each passage as a separate refutation without a shared spatial model.
structural_cues: The branchless means-root at 17:57 structurally names an approach sought by the invoked beings.
The same route noun occurs in 17:42 and the focus, first as something alleged peers would seek and then as something the example-makers cannot find.

activation_trace.role: Makes reflective seeing the focus demand whose success cannot be taken for granted.
Supplies the comparison as a potentially instructive sign or lesson.
Names the directional failure that can follow exposure to evidence.
Provides manifest signs as evidence presented for recognition.
Intensifies the sign as visibly perceptible rather than merely reported.
Contributes active showing, turning vision into presented evidence.
Makes presented vision an assay that discloses the receiver's condition.
Marks evidence as followed by growth rather than correction.
Names the resulting growth as transgressive excess beyond the orienting limit.

changed_reading.after: Their model-making can metabolize even visible signs and shown visions into tests that expose and intensify the same loss of direction.
changed_reading.before: Clearer examples or stronger visible evidence should cure their error.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible sign can be denied, and a shown vision can become a test whose warning is followed by increased excess. The command to look therefore does not assume that more imagery automatically guides; their comparison habit converts presented evidence into material for further wandering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible evidence and worsening reception; I infer that the focus comparisons describe the receiver's processing of signs, not a shortage of signs. The test may expose rather than cause the excess, so causal direction remains qualified.
structural_cues: In 17:59 a visible sign is denied, while 17:60 sequences shown vision, testing, warning, increase, and excess.

activation_trace.role: Adds incitement toward action as an exploratory force within the act of striking a comparison.
Adds agitation and unstable motion as the social effect of the utterance.
Supplies overt speech as the medium in which the relational effect occurs.
Supplies verbal incitement that damages relations between hearers.

changed_reading.after: Their likenesses can be agitative speech tools that move audiences apart and thereby manufacture the social conditions of straying.
changed_reading.before: Their likenesses are static propositions held by isolated minds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The comparison is also a social speech act. Against the command for the best speech, hostile prompting inserts a verbal wedge between people; the focus act of striking can therefore carry an agitative force that makes the imposed likeness move an audience, not merely describe a target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, relational incitement, and focus comparison-making; I infer that the accusation's function is to agitate following relations. The striking branch is form-distant, so the ordinary representational sense remains primary.
structural_cues: 17:53 opposes saying what is best to an adversarial act that works between people.

remaining_uncertainties: The focus may point primarily backward to the bewitched-man accusation or forward to the resurrection analogies; both mechanisms remain independently anchored.
The packet associates receptive barriers with the missing route but does not settle whether they cause refusal or describe its consequence.
The obedience coloring within the capacity root is meaningful but should remain secondary to direct ability.
The eye-film route branch is deliberately contained as an exploratory perceptual overlay.
strongest_changes: The immediately preceding accusation fixes one comparison as typecasting that redirects whom an audience follows.
The material and resurrection sequence turns inability from material impossibility into failed willing compliance that the future call overrides.
Route-seeking, dependent intermediaries, and failed control recast no-way as the collapse of a theological topology.
Visible signs and shown vision demonstrate that more representation can expose or intensify wandering rather than automatically cure it.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is reflexive: it asks the reader to inspect how models are made. Context then supplies rival uses of representation - varied reminder, accusatory label, material thought-model, visible sign, and tested vision - so the central failure is not lack of imagery but a way of processing imagery that hides its object, closes its route, and moves other people.

activation_trace.role: Offers an eye-covering film as an exploratory image for a route made unavailable to sight.
Keeps the outlier attached to the verse's explicit demand for perceptual and reflective seeing.

changed_reading.before: No route means only that no road or argumentative means can be found.

It remains anchored at focus word 9 and is activated by nearby barriers and explicit seeing; downstream prose should carry it only as a secondary perceptual overlay, never as a replacement translation.

It remains anchored in the focus command to inspect and the punishment-example branch, with denial and destruction nearby; downstream prose should present it as rhetorical reflexivity, not as the noun's sole lexical sense.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Misapplied likeness destroys practical route-finding.** `ض ر ب:B003/B009` sets an example and impresses a disposition, `م ث ل:B001/B004` gives likeness and description, `ض ل ل:B001/B003` strays and loses location, and `ط و ع:B003` practical capacity. Their analogies label the messenger, then the result is inability to find a way. I infer a false comparison reorganizes perception until available paths become unusable. Error reads as model-induced incapacity, not mere lack of information.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:90–93 produces an entire series of models and conditions that still withhold assent. The later escalation confirms that analogy has become a path-blocking demand generator.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Bad representations damage the map used to find a route.** Lexical evidence: `ض ر ب B003` (setting forth an example) in `ضَرَبُوا۟`, `م ث ل B008` (representation or image) in `ٱلْأَمْثَالَ`, `ض ل ل B001` (going astray from guidance and aim) in `فَضَلُّوا۟`, and `ط و ع B003` (ability and practical capacity) in `يَسْتَطِيعُونَ`. Structural cue: 17:47 supplies the representation “a bewitched man”; 17:49–51 adds material impossibility-images, and the result is negated `سَبِيلًا`. Assigned role: representations model reality, but distorted models remove aim and then practical route-capacity. Abductive move: the text supplies example, straying, and inability; I infer that the first causes the latter two by corrupting orientation. Reading change: the comparisons are not harmless rhetoric: they disable the conceptual map by which a viable way could be recognized.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:49–51 supplied the concrete bad maps, and 17:52 supplied their correction: a single effective call creates the route of return the objectors declared unavailable.

words.gloss_range: commanded looking as reflective inspection of the manner-clause, not mere eyesight toward an object
words.prose: {{ar:ٱنظُرْ}} ({{tr:unẓur}}) opens with a direct singular command, so the Prophet is not merely told a report but is made the disciplined observer of their method. Its object is the following how-clause, which narrows the root's broad seeing range into reflective inspection of the analogy-making mechanism. The formula belongs with other command-to-look frames, including the same-surah contrast at 17:21, the exposed falsehood at 6:24, and the near reprise at 25:9. Under this command, their act, straying, and inability become one displayed diagnosis, while the boundary from the previous accusation makes the recited shift from their corrupted reception to divine address audible without changing the command's grammar.

words.gloss_range: completed active coining or setting forth of comparisons, with the Prophet as targeted dative and the similitudes as object
words.prose: {{ar:ضَرَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:ḍarabū}}) is a completed active act: they have manufactured the comparisons, and the plural ending keeps the prior accusation-makers responsible. The idiom with {{ar:ٱلْأَمْثَالَ}} ({{tr:al-amthāla}}) selects setting forth similitudes, while the root's striking and impressing pressure makes the speech feel like imposed categorization rather than neutral illustration. The same parable-making idiom can clarify when divinely used, as in 13:17, 14:24, and 16:74, but here human agents turn it polemically against the Prophet. Travel-like pressure survives only as contrast, since the local wording is not a travel construction; against 2:273, those who set comparisons in motion end unable to find a path. The completed act also starts the result chain that 25:9 repeats.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَمْثَالَ}} ({{tr:al-amthāla}}) names what they manufacture: not one stray comparison, but a definite plural set of recognizable comparison-frames. The root's likeness and representation range makes these similitudes feel like models imposed on the Prophet, while the local idiom keeps them as rhetorical comparisons rather than every possible derivative sense. words.gloss_range: an indefinite path, route, or means of access denied under negation, completing the failed-capacity frame
words.prose: {{ar:سَبِيلًۭا}} ({{tr:sabīlan}}) closes the ayah by naming the missing object of capacity. Its indefinite singular form under negation denies even one viable route, not merely the right route, and its accusative role ties that denial to the preceding ability verb. The word's path, means, and flowing-course range makes the ending both navigational and practical: after straying, they lack direction and access. The closure also resonates with 2:108, where straying from the even path is reversed here into no path at all; within Surah 17, route language moves through 17:32 and 17:42 before this no-path verdict, and 25:9 repeats the same terminal diagnosis. The final indefinite cadence turns the prior accusation about following back onto the accusers as their own navigational failure.
